about: The introitus of the formulary “Saint Joachim, Confessor” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: He has distributed widely, he has given to the poor; his justice endures forever and ever; his horn will be exalted in glory. Blessed is the man who fears the Lord; he longs greatly for His commandments. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. He has distributed widely, he has given to the poor; his justice endures forever and ever; his horn will be exalted in glory.
